activeKey.zh-CN: 当前激活的标签页的 itemKey，受控。传 `null` 时不激活任何标签页，仍是受控；不传或为 `undefined` 时按非受控处理。
activeKey.en-US: The itemKey of the active tab, controlled. `null` activates no tab and is still controlled; omitted or `undefined` means uncontrolled.

arrowPosition.zh-CN: 折叠模式下，左右切换箭头的位置，可选 `start`、`end` 或 `both`。
arrowPosition.en-US: Position of the scroll arrows in collapsible mode: `start`, `end` or `both`.

children.zh-CN: TabPane 子元素，必须是 Tabs 的直接子元素；其余节点按原顺序作为内容渲染。传了 tabList 时，TabPane 子元素被忽略，其余节点是当前标签页的内容。
children.en-US: TabPane children, which must be direct children of Tabs; any other node renders as content in its original order. With tabList, TabPane children are ignored and the other nodes are the content of the active tab.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

collapsible.zh-CN: 是否开启滚动折叠（仅水平模式）。传 `auto` 时在标签溢出或换行时自动折叠，放得下时自动退出。
collapsible.en-US: Whether to collapse overflowing tabs into a scrollable bar (horizontal mode only). `auto` collapses when the tabs overflow or wrap and leaves the collapse once they fit.

contentStyle.zh-CN: 内容区域外层的样式对象。
contentStyle.en-US: Style of the outer content area.

defaultActiveKey.zh-CN: 非受控时初始选中的 itemKey。不传时取第一个启用且有 itemKey 的标签页。
defaultActiveKey.en-US: The itemKey selected initially when uncontrolled. Omitted, the first enabled tab with an itemKey is selected.

dropdownProps.zh-CN: 折叠模式下，分别透传给起始侧（`start`）与末尾侧（`end`）箭头下拉菜单的 Dropdown 属性。
dropdownProps.en-US: In collapsible mode, the Dropdown props passed to the start-side (`start`) and end-side (`end`) arrow menus.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 使用 TabPane 子元素时，是否渲染未激活面板的 DOM。为 `false` 时只渲染当前面板，没有切换动画。
keepDOM.en-US: With TabPane children, whether to render the DOM of inactive panels. When `false`, only the active panel is rendered and panels switch without motion.

lazyRender.zh-CN: 懒渲染：面板被激活过才渲染内容，之后保留。
lazyRender.en-US: Lazy rendering: a panel renders its content only after it has been active, and keeps it afterwards.

more.zh-CN: 将末尾的一部分标签页收入「更多」下拉菜单。传数字时表示收入菜单的标签数；传对象时 `count` 为标签数，`render` 返回自定义触发器，`dropdownProps` 透传给下拉菜单。
more.en-US: Moves the last tabs into a More dropdown. A number is the count of tabs moved; an object sets `count` to that number, `render` returns a custom trigger and `dropdownProps` is passed to the dropdown.

onChange.zh-CN: 切换标签页时触发，参数为新激活的 itemKey。
onChange.en-US: Called when the active tab changes, with the itemKey of the new active tab.

onTabClick.zh-CN: 单击，或用 Enter、Space 激活标签页时触发，参数为 itemKey 与事件；键盘激活时事件是 `KeyboardEvent`。
onTabClick.en-US: Called when a tab is clicked or activated with Enter or Space, with the itemKey and the event; the event is a `KeyboardEvent` for keyboard activation.

onTabClose.zh-CN: 关闭标签页时触发，参数为被关闭标签页的 itemKey。标签页的移除由使用方完成。
onTabClose.en-US: Called when a tab is closed, with the itemKey of the closed tab. The caller removes the tab.

onVisibleTabsChange.zh-CN: 折叠模式下溢出项的可见状态变化时触发，参数为 `Map<string, boolean>`，键为 itemKey，值表示该标签页是否可见。
onVisibleTabsChange.en-US: In collapsible mode, called when the visibility of the tabs changes, with a `Map<string, boolean>` from itemKey to whether the tab is visible.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 组件内部调用 `focus` 时，是否阻止浏览器滚动文档以显示新聚焦的元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focus calls inside the component stop the browser from scrolling the document to show the newly focused element.

renderArrow.zh-CN: 替换折叠模式下的每个滚动箭头。参数依次为溢出的 `items`、位置 `pos`、点击处理函数 `handleArrowClick` 与默认箭头 `defaultNode`。
renderArrow.en-US: Replaces each scroll arrow in collapsible mode. The arguments are the overflowed `items`, the position `pos`, the click handler `handleArrowClick` and the default arrow `defaultNode`.

renderTabBar.zh-CN: 替换整个标签栏，每次渲染都会调用。参数为标签栏属性 `tabBarProps` 与默认标签栏组件 `defaultTabBar`。用它替换标签栏时，`aria-label` 与 `aria-labelledby` 在 `tabBarProps` 中，需要自行写在 `role="tablist"` 的元素上。
renderTabBar.en-US: Replaces the whole tab bar, called on every render. The arguments are the tab bar props `tabBarProps` and the default tab bar component `defaultTabBar`. When replacing the tab bar, `aria-label` and `aria-labelledby` are in `tabBarProps` and must be set on the element with `role="tablist"`.

showRestInDropdown.zh-CN: 折叠模式下，是否将收起的标签页展示在下拉菜单中。
showRestInDropdown.en-US: In collapsible mode, whether the collapsed tabs are listed in a dropdown menu.

size.zh-CN: 标签栏尺寸，可选 `small`、`medium` 或 `large`；目前仅线条式（`line`）标签栏支持。
size.en-US: Size of the tab bar: `small`, `medium` or `large`. Currently only the `line` type supports it.

tabBarClassName.en-US: Class name of the tab bar.

tabBarExtraContent.zh-CN: 标签栏的附加内容，位于 tablist 之外。
tabBarExtraContent.en-US: Extra content of the tab bar, placed outside the tablist.

tabList.zh-CN: 标签页的数据数组，每项含 `itemKey`、`tab`、`icon`、`disabled`、`closable`。只要传了数组（含空数组），`children` 就是当前标签页的内容，并优先于 TabPane 子元素。
tabList.en-US: An array of tab data, each with `itemKey`, `tab`, `icon`, `disabled` and `closable`. Any array, even an empty one, makes `children` the content of the active tab and takes precedence over TabPane children.

tabPaneMotion.zh-CN: 切换面板时是否使用动画。

tabPosition.zh-CN: 标签栏位置：`top` 为水平，`left` 为垂直。
tabPosition.en-US: Position of the tab bar: `top` is horizontal, `left` is vertical.

type.zh-CN: 标签栏样式，可选 `line`、`card`、`button`、`slash`；`slash` 仅支持水平模式。
type.en-US: Style of the tab bar: `line`, `card`, `button` or `slash`. `slash` supports horizontal mode only.

visibleTabsStyle.zh-CN: 折叠模式下，整体滚动区域的样式对象。
visibleTabsStyle.en-US: In collapsible mode, the style of the whole scrolling area.

className.en-US: Class name of the panel root element (`role="tabpanel"`).

closable.zh-CN: 是否允许关闭该标签页，关闭时触发 Tabs 的 `onTabClose`。
closable.en-US: Whether the tab can be closed; closing calls `onTabClose` of the Tabs.

icon.zh-CN: 标签栏中该标签的图标，由 Tabs 渲染。
icon.en-US: Icon of the tab in the tab bar, rendered by the Tabs.

itemKey.zh-CN: 标签页的唯一标识，对应 Tabs 的 `activeKey`。
itemKey.en-US: Unique key of the tab, matched against the `activeKey` of the Tabs.

ref.en-US: Reference to the panel root element (`role="tabpanel"`).

style.zh-CN: 面板根元素的样式对象。
style.en-US: Style of the panel root element.

tab.zh-CN: 标签栏中该标签的内容，由 Tabs 渲染。
tab.en-US: Content of the tab in the tab bar, rendered by the Tabs.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

closable.en-US: Whether to show the close button.

deleteTabItem.zh-CN: 点击关闭按钮时的处理函数，参数为 itemKey 与事件。在 Tabs 内默认使用 Tabs 的处理函数，通常无需设置。
deleteTabItem.en-US: Handler for the close button, called with the itemKey and the event. Inside Tabs it defaults to the handler of the Tabs, so it is usually not set.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用；禁用时点击与关闭按钮均不生效，关闭按钮仍会显示。
disabled.en-US: Whether the tab is disabled; clicks and the close button have no effect, while the close button is still shown.

handleKeyDown.zh-CN: 键盘处理函数，参数为事件、itemKey 与 closable。在 Tabs 内默认使用 Tabs 的键盘处理函数，通常无需设置。
handleKeyDown.en-US: Keyboard handler, called with the event, the itemKey and closable. Inside Tabs it defaults to the keyboard handler of the Tabs, so it is usually not set.

icon.zh-CN: 标签图标；没有内容则不渲染图标。
icon.en-US: Tab icon; no icon is rendered without content.

itemKey.zh-CN: 标签的唯一标识，对应 Tabs 的 `activeKey`。
itemKey.en-US: Unique key of the tab, matched against the `activeKey` of the Tabs.

onClick.zh-CN: 单击标签时触发，参数为 itemKey 与事件；禁用时不触发。TabItem 本身不会选中标签页，需在回调中更新 Tabs 的 `activeKey`。
onClick.en-US: Called when the tab is clicked, with the itemKey and the event; not called while disabled. TabItem does not select the tab itself: update the `activeKey` of the Tabs in the callback.

ref.en-US: Reference to the tab root element (`role="tab"`).

selected.zh-CN: 是否为选中状态，影响样式与 `aria-selected`。
selected.en-US: Whether the tab is selected, which affects its style and `aria-selected`.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，`small` 与 `medium` 会添加对应的类名。
size.en-US: Size; `small` and `medium` add the matching class name.

tabPosition.zh-CN: 位置，未设置时取所在 Tabs 的 `tabPosition`。
tabPosition.en-US: Position; defaults to the `tabPosition` of the enclosing Tabs.

type.zh-CN: 样式，未设置时取所在 Tabs 的 `type`。
type.en-US: Style; defaults to the `type` of the enclosing Tabs.
